subject: Plan: Commit uplift, tier rebalancing & soft-rate redistribution
messages:
From: Anna Priestley <anna@storify.co>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need to expand our hosted commit and rework rate caps

Hi Lauren,

Quick note from the Storify product team — our Q4 roadmap accelerated and we expect a 3x spike in generation volume starting mid-September. We just finished a spike run and the current hosted plan is throttling some background processes (embedding refreshes + inference for recommendations).

We are interested in moving from our current monthly commit (200M tokens) up to 750M tokens, and we'd like to smooth the rate limits so our batch workers don't hit the soft throttle. Two asks:

- Can you send an updated proposal with a monthly commit at that level and a suggested soft-rate redistribution that keeps tail latency predictable?
- Any pro-rated pricing for the remainder of our contract (ends 2027-03-31) and the SOW changes we should expect?

Cc'ing Marcus from infra — he can share logs if helpful.

Thanks,

Anna Priestley
Head of Product, Storify
anna@storify.co

--
Storify Inc.
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Anna Priestley <anna@storify.co>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus@storify.co>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need to expand our hosted commit and rework rate caps

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the accelerated roadmap.

I can absolutely put together a proposal and a staging plan so we don’t break anything in production. Quick items I’ll include: a revised monthly commit price at 750M tokens, a soft-rate redistribution for background batch windows, options for burst pockets, and a pro‑rata amendment to carry through to your contract renewal.

Two quick asks from my side:
- Can Marcus share an example traffic distribution (PS: 1‑hour window during peak vs. 24h avg) so we can model KV cache impact?
- Do you want a single-line SOW amendment or a short addendum + a new SOW (Ops prefers addendum unless there are new SLAs)?

I’ll loop in our sales engineer (Ben) and ops (Vanessa) to confirm feasibility and delivery timeline. Expect a draft by Thursday (20 Aug).

Best,

— Lauren Bishop
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 17 Aug 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Storify uplift — ops feasibility and recommended guardrails

LAUREN / BEN — internal notes before we send the proposal:

Summary: Storify wants 200M -> 750M monthly commit, sustained uplift. Primary risk is tail latency during concurrent embedding refresh + synchronous generate requests. Recommended approach:

1) Tier rebalancing: keep hosted model variant as primary (r1-medium) and add a read-only r2-high variant for bulk batch jobs. Route interactive traffic to r1-medium with strict per-route rate limits and a KV cache TTL bump.

2) Soft-rate redistribution: implement sliding windows for background jobs — allocate a 40% burst pocket for nightly refresh (00:00-04:00 PT) and a soft cap that triggers graceful 429 with Retry-After for non-critical batches.

3) Cost modeling: propose three pricing bands — 750M committed (discounted unit), 1.25B commit (further step discount), and overage at blended token rate. Include a 60-day monitor & rollback clause.

4) Pro‑rata amendment: Ops prefers an addendum for the remainder of current term; new SOW only if Storify needs SLA changes (e.g., 99.9 -> 99.95).

Attachments to include in proposal: pricing sheet (Commit_Uplift_Proposal_Storify_v2.pdf), draft addendum template (SOW-2026-Storify.docx), and a traffic-sample CSV if Marcus provides it.

Timeline: draft ready 20 Aug, internal review 21 Aug, send to customer 21 Aug EOD.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Ops | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Anna Priestley <anna@storify.co>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus@storify.co>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal & next steps: Storify commit uplift (draft)

Hi Anna / Marcus — thanks for the patience. Attached is a draft proposal and the addendum template. Highlights below so we’re aligned before internal approvals:

- Proposed committed tiers:
  • 750M tokens / month — Commit Tier A (effective 2026-09-15) — 18% unit discount vs current
  • 1.25B tokens / month — Commit Tier B (optional stepped upgrade) — 28% unit discount
  • Overage applies at blended overage rate; we recommend a ~5% buffer for initial month to avoid unexpected throttles.

- Rate & routing recommendations (ops):
  • Background batch window (00:00–04:00 PT): allocate a 40% burst pocket with a soft cap guard that returns 429 + Retry-After for non-critical batch jobs.
  • Interactive traffic pinned to primary variant (r1-medium) with tightened per-route quotas to keep 95th percentile latency within SLO.
  • Optional: move long-running batch reads to r2-high (lower unit cost for large batched KV cache reuse).

- Contracting: we propose a short-term addendum (pro‑rata amendment) that increases the monthly commit starting 2026-09-15 and rolls into the existing renewal cadence. If you want the higher SLA, we can convert to a new SOW and adjust pricing accordingly.

Next steps:
1) Marcus: can you confirm a sample 24h traffic CSV by EOD Monday so Ops can validate the burst window sizing?
2) Anna: confirm whether you want us to push the change on 2026-09-01 (earlier) or 2026-09-15 (recommended).
3) Ben/Vanessa: I’ve put the draft pricing and addendum in the Drive link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-storify-upgrade — please review and flag any operational blockers.

Attachments: Commit_Uplift_Proposal_Storify_v2.pdf, SOW-2026-Storify.docx

Looking forward to your confirmation — we can also hop on a 30 min call tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,

— Lauren Bishop
